decisions.reason: Uses Junction LinkType/Target and the cordis.patch.yml link: marker to show the profile entry resolves to the repo; explains edits are already deployed and copying is a self-copy acting on the same files; contrasts with a copied install.

Attributes both EBUSY handles and stale served/cached client.js to the running dsh host; tab close releases nothing; separates browser HTTP cache from filesystem lock and requires host restart plus cache-bypassing refresh.

Explains rename through the junction renamed the sole repo files, making the subsequent source copy fail; restores both .old2 files via Rename-Item, notes content preserved, verifies with node --check, then activates; stopping the host first is an optional precaution.
Gives the semantic order: fully stop host, restart, hard-refresh with cache bypass, then verify feature/served bytes and no console errors; states restart-before-refresh and why either alone fails.

Provides pre-flight Get-Item LinkType/Target plus marker inspection before any file operation with linked-vs-copied branching, and explains why generic copy-into-node_modules advice is destructive for link installs.

caps.reason: Final plan explicitly renames back with no copy step and rejects copying through the junction; the bad copy appears only as rejected diagnosis.
Final plan stops and restarts the host before the hard refresh; browser-only closure/refresh is explicitly rejected.
